title: Amazon API Gateway REST API to AWS Lambda
description: Create an Amazon API Gateway REST API that invokes an AWS Lambda function

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern deploys an Amazon API Gateway REST API with a default route and basic CORS configuration. The default route is integrated with an AWS Lambda function written in TypeScript. The function logs the incoming API event (v2) and context object to an Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group and returns basic information about the event to the caller.

testing.headline: Testing
text: 1. Once the application is deployed, retrieve the ServiceEndpoint value from CloudFormation Outputs. Either browse to the endpoint in a web browser or call the endpoint from Postman.
2. See the repo for additional testing notes.

cleanup.headline: Cleanup
text: 2. Confirm the stack has been deleted: aws cloudformation list-stacks --query "StackSummaries[?contains(StackName,'STACK_NAME')].StackStatus"
